0.0: Thank you for helping me. I have nothing, yet you came to my aid. Thank you.

1.0: This is a special piece of shoulder armor I've had for ages. I don't even remember where I got it.
1.1: It's showing its age, but I am sure it still holds great power. It will protect you.
